articles.summary: Ameriprise Financial, Inc. (NYSE: AMP) has been recognized by TIME as one of “America’s Best Companies” for 2026, based on employee satisfaction, financial performance and sustainability transparency. Ameriprise is also the top-ranked banking and financial services company headquartered in Minnesota on the list. “For more than half of America’s history, Ameriprise has helped millions of people plan for a confident financial future. That purpose continues to guide how we serve clients today,” said Jim Cracchiolo, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Ameriprise Financial . “Being named one of ‘America’s Best Companies’ by TIME reflects the trust we’ve earned with clients, the strength of our business and an exceptional team that continues to set Ameriprise apart. articles.summary: The teams cite industry-leading technology, breadth of capabilities, and strong, supportive leadership as key factors in their decisions to join Ameriprise Financial, Inc. (NYSE: AMP) today announced that three established financial advisor teams managing nearly $1.2 billion in combined client assets have recently joined its branch channel from RBC Capital Markets, LLC. The teams include The GEN Group in Vienna, Va., Vantage Axia Wealth in Denver, Colo., and Chad Lewis in West Des Moines, Iowa. The GEN Group joins for industry-leading technology and breadth of capabilities The GEN Group, led by private wealth advisor Matt Lanham and financial advisor Amanda Catalina, has joined in Vienna, Va., with over $750 million in client assets. The team also includes client service associates Nicole Aguinaldo and Ari Aguinaldo . articles.summary: Ameriprise Financial, Inc. (NYSE: AMP) today announced it has been named to Newsweek’s list of “America’s Greatest Workplaces” for 2026, recognizing the firm’s commitment to building a supportive, inclusive and high-performing culture for employees. The annual list highlights top employers across the country based on employee feedback and an independent evaluation of workplace experience and satisfaction. “Helping clients feel confident about their financial future starts with supporting the people who make that mission possible,” said Kelli Hunter Petruzillo, Executive Vice President of Human Resources at Ameriprise . “We're proud to foster a workplace where employees feel valued, have opportunities to grow in their careers and are empowered to make a meaningful difference every day.
